dialect: HiveQL (ParseDriver.parse without a Configuration: default lexer, standard quoted-identifier handling)
parser_family: Apache Hive ANTLR3 HiveQL grammar (HiveLexer/HiveParser and its imported FromClause, SelectClause and Identifiers parsers) building ANTLR ASTNode trees; independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite, JSqlParser and the Presto/Trino and Spark ANTLR4 grammars
api: new ParseDriver().parse(local SQL text without its terminating semicolon).getTree() -> ASTNode; the harness walks the tree by token type (TOK_TABNAME, TOK_SELEXPR, TOK_JOIN family, TOK_WHERE, TOK_GROUPBY, TOK_ORDERBY, TOK_FUNCTION/TOK_FUNCTIONSTAR, TOK_INSERT_INTO, TOK_TABCOLNAME, Number and StringLiteral tokens)
coverage: JaCoCo bytecode coverage of org.apache.hive:hive-exec:4.2.1 org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.parse classes that belong to the hive-parser module (hand-written ParseDriver, ASTNode and lexer helpers plus the ANTLR 3.5.2 HiveLexer and HiveParser regenerated from the pinned grammar sources, with line tables checked against the shipped classes) during valid-control replay; Jazzer fuzz entry
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8; the adapter removes one terminating semicolon and trailing whitespace, as the Hive CLI and Beeline do, and calls ParseDriver.parse without a Configuration. Valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. parse takes one statement, so statement_count is 1 by API contract. Hive's grammar rewrites VALUES rows into inline(array(struct(...))) calls; rows are the struct calls. Configuration-dependent lexing and HiveQL-only syntax are untested.
